name: Astronomy in Minutes
author: Giles Sparrow
short_description: A quick guide to understanding astronomy.
detailed_description: Astronomy in Minutes explains the vast universe in short and easily understandable sections. The book introduces readers to stars, galaxies, black holes, cosmology, and the evolution of the universe. It simplifies complex astronomical theories and discoveries into concise explanations, making it ideal for beginners who want to grasp how the universe works.

name: Eternal Echoes
author: Sadhguru
short_description: A reflective exploration of human thoughts and timeless ideas.
detailed_description: Eternal Echoes reflects on ideas that transcend time such as identity, memory, love, and spiritual awareness. Through reflective writing and philosophical observations, the book explores how human experiences echo across generations and how thoughts and emotions shape our perception of life.

name: The Incredible Banker
author: Ravi Subramanian
short_description: A corporate thriller set in the banking world.
detailed_description: The Incredible Banker is a fast-paced story that dives into the world of corporate banking, ambition, power struggles, and ethical dilemmas. It follows professionals navigating the intense pressures of the financial industry while dealing with ambition, personal values, and the consequences of decisions.

name: Hyperfocus
author: Chris Bailey
short_description: A guide to improving concentration and deep work.
detailed_description: Hyperfocus explores how attention works and how people can train their minds to focus better in a distracted world. The book explains two important mental states—hyperfocus and scatterfocus—and provides practical strategies to improve productivity, creativity, and mental clarity.

name: Get Epic Shit Done
author: Ankur Warikoo
short_description: Motivational advice for achieving personal goals.
detailed_description: Get Epic Shit Done encourages readers to build discipline, self-awareness, and clarity in their lives. Through personal experiences and practical tips, the book shows how small consistent actions, strong habits, and the right mindset can help individuals achieve meaningful success.

name: Healing Is the New High
author: Vex King
short_description: A guide to emotional healing and inner peace.
detailed_description: Healing Is the New High focuses on self-love, emotional recovery, and spiritual growth. Vex King explains how unresolved trauma, negative thoughts, and emotional pain can affect life and provides tools such as mindfulness, affirmations, and inner work to achieve healing.

name: The Secret
author: Rhonda Byrne
short_description: A book about the law of attraction.
detailed_description: The Secret introduces the concept of the law of attraction, which suggests that positive thoughts attract positive outcomes. The book teaches readers to visualize goals, maintain gratitude, and align their mindset with success and abundance.

name: Do Epic Shit
author: Ankur Warikoo
short_description: Life lessons about ambition and personal growth.
detailed_description: Do Epic Shit contains short reflections on success, failure, discipline, and happiness. Warikoo shares insights from his career and life experiences to inspire readers to take bold decisions and build meaningful lives.

name: Van Gogh
author: Various
short_description: A study of the life and art of Vincent Van Gogh.
detailed_description: This book explores the life of Vincent Van Gogh, one of the most influential painters in art history. It examines his artistic style, emotional struggles, and groundbreaking paintings that shaped modern art.

name: Ikigai
author: Hector Garcia and Francesc Miralles
short_description: The Japanese philosophy of finding purpose.
detailed_description: Ikigai explores the Japanese idea of living with purpose and balance. The book studies how people in Okinawa live long, meaningful lives by combining passion, mission, vocation, and profession.

name: How to Win Friends and Influence People
author: Dale Carnegie
short_description: Classic book on communication and relationships.
detailed_description: This timeless book teaches principles of effective communication, leadership, and human relations. Dale Carnegie explains how empathy, appreciation, and positive influence can strengthen relationships and help individuals succeed in personal and professional life.

name: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
short_description: A system for building good habits.
detailed_description: Atomic Habits explains how small daily improvements can lead to remarkable results. James Clear introduces a framework for building good habits, breaking bad ones, and designing systems that make success easier.

name: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
short_description: A history of humankind.
detailed_description: Sapiens traces the history of humanity from ancient hunter-gatherers to modern technological societies. Harari explains how biology, culture, economics, and religion shaped human civilization.

name: The Psychology of Money
author: Morgan Housel
short_description: Understanding how people think about money.
detailed_description: The Psychology of Money explores how human behavior influences financial decisions. Through stories and real-life examples, Morgan Housel explains why patience, discipline, and emotional control are essential for financial success.

name: Chirikkunna Marapava
author: Vaikom Muhammad Basheer
short_description: A Malayalam literary work.
detailed_description: This novel reflects Basheer's unique storytelling style combining humor, philosophy, and human emotions. It explores the absurdities and beauty of life through simple yet profound narratives.

name: Viddikalude Swargam
author: Vaikom Muhammad Basheer
short_description: A satirical Malayalam novel.
detailed_description: Viddikalude Swargam portrays human foolishness and societal hypocrisy with humor and satire. Basheer's writing exposes human weaknesses while celebrating innocence and compassion.

name: Dopamine Detox
author: Thibaut Meurisse
short_description: Reducing distractions and improving focus.
detailed_description: Dopamine Detox explains how overstimulation from social media, entertainment, and instant gratification can damage focus and motivation. The book teaches strategies to reset the brain and regain discipline.

name: Pranayathinte Moonnam Kannu
author: K. V. Mohankumar
short_description: A Malayalam romantic novel.
detailed_description: This novel explores love, emotions, and relationships through deep psychological and emotional storytelling, portraying how love transforms individuals.

name: Who Moved My Cheese
author: Spencer Johnson
short_description: A story about dealing with change.
detailed_description: Through a simple allegory of characters searching for cheese in a maze, the book teaches how people react to change and why adaptability is essential for success.

name: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
short_description: A spiritual journey to follow one's dreams.
detailed_description: The Alchemist follows Santiago, a shepherd who travels in search of treasure and discovers deeper truths about destiny, faith, and the pursuit of dreams.

name: Francis Ittikora
author: T. D. Ramakrishnan
detailed_description: A historical thriller exploring the legend of Francis Ittikora, a mysterious figure connected to global trade networks and hidden histories.

name: The Valkyries
author: Paulo Coelho
detailed_description: The Valkyries narrates Coelho’s spiritual journey in the Mojave Desert where he confronts fears and seeks contact with angels.

name: Premalekhanam
author: Vaikom Muhammad Basheer
detailed_description: A humorous and romantic Malayalam novel about love between two individuals from different religious backgrounds.

name: Cheviyorkuka Anthimakahalam
author: Vaikom Muhammad Basheer
detailed_description: A philosophical narrative reflecting on life, mortality, and human experiences.

name: Ego Is the Enemy
author: Ryan Holiday
detailed_description: The book explains how ego can destroy success and teaches humility, discipline, and self-awareness.

name: Ormakuripp
author: Vaikom Muhammad Basheer
detailed_description: A reflective memoir capturing Basheer’s memories, struggles, and insights about life.

name: Think Like a Monk
author: Jay Shetty
detailed_description: Jay Shetty explains how monk wisdom can help modern people develop clarity, peace, and purpose.

name: Outgrowing God
author: Richard Dawkins
detailed_description: A critical examination of religion encouraging rational thinking and scientific understanding.

name: The Magic
author: Rhonda Byrne
detailed_description: A follow-up to The Secret focusing on gratitude practices to transform life.

name: Mindf*cked
author: Anubhav Agrawal
detailed_description: A collection of raw poetry expressing heartbreak, love, and emotional struggles.

name: Aadujeevitham
author: Benyamin
detailed_description: A powerful Malayalam novel about a migrant worker’s struggle for survival in the Arabian desert.

name: Vythyastharakan
author: Dr Alexander Jacob
detailed_description: An inspiring account of leadership and ethical service by IPS officer Alexander Jacob.

name: Sex, Power and Money
author: Osho
detailed_description: Osho discusses humanity’s obsession with power, sexuality, and wealth while encouraging deeper awareness.

name: Jesus Lived in India
author: Holger Kersten
detailed_description: A controversial historical theory suggesting that Jesus traveled to India during his life.

name: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck
author: Mark Manson
detailed_description: A counter-intuitive guide encouraging people to focus only on what truly matters in life.

name: The Telomere Effect
author: Elizabeth Blackburn
detailed_description: Explains how lifestyle choices influence aging at the cellular level through telomeres.

name: The Constitution of India
author: B. R. Ambedkar
detailed_description: The foundational legal document outlining India’s political structure, rights, and governance.

name: The Art of Seduction
author: Robert Greene
detailed_description: A study of historical seduction strategies and psychological influence.

name: The Immortals of Meluha
author: Amish Tripathi
detailed_description: A reimagining of Lord Shiva’s journey in an ancient civilization blending mythology with fiction.

name: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
author: J. K. Rowling
detailed_description: Harry competes in the dangerous Triwizard Tournament while dark forces gather strength.

name: The Power of Your Subconscious Mind
author: Joseph Murphy
detailed_description: A classic book explaining how subconscious beliefs influence success, health, and happiness.

name: Mario's Goa
author: Mario de Miranda
short_description: A humorous illustrated portrayal of life and culture in Goa.
detailed_description: Mario's Goa is a beautifully illustrated book by the legendary Indian cartoonist Mario de Miranda. Through lively sketches and witty observations, the book captures the everyday life, traditions, festivals, architecture, and social scenes of Goa. Mario's signature cartoon style humorously portrays Goan culture, local characters, and the relaxed coastal lifestyle, making the book both a cultural document and an artistic celebration of Goa.

name: The 48 Laws of Power
author: Robert Greene
detailed_description: A famous guide exploring historical strategies used by powerful figures to gain influence and control.

name: I Too Had a Love Story
author: Ravinder Singh
short_description: A true love story that ends in heartbreak — an emotional autobiographical novel.
detailed_description: I Too Had a Love Story is the debut novel of Ravinder Singh, based on his own life. The story follows Ravin, a software engineer who, on his friends' suggestion, creates a profile on a matrimonial website. He connects with Khushi, a girl from Delhi, and they fall deeply in love through long calls and heartfelt conversations, despite never meeting initially. Their chemistry blossoms when they finally meet in person and begin planning for marriage. But tragedy strikes when Khushi meets with a devastating accident just before their wedding — and does not survive. The book is a moving tribute to a love that was real, brief, and eternal. It is one of India's most beloved contemporary romantic novels, known for making readers cry and feel deeply. The book carries the dedication: 'To the loving memory of the girl whom I loved, yet could not marry.'

name: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
short_description: A timeless classic about love, class, and the courage to defy first impressions.
detailed_description: Pride and Prejudice, first published in 1813, is one of the most celebrated novels in English literature. The story centres on Elizabeth Bennet, the second of five daughters in the Bennet family, as she navigates love, social expectations, and her own sharp wit. When the wealthy and seemingly arrogant Mr. Fitzwilliam Darcy enters her world, Elizabeth is immediately put off by his pride, while Darcy is unsettled by his growing attraction to her. Through misunderstandings, revelations, and the interference of society's rigid class system, both characters are forced to confront their own prejudices and pride. The novel brilliantly critiques the social conventions of 19th-century England — particularly the pressure on women to marry for financial security rather than love. With its iconic characters, sharp dialogue, and deep emotional intelligence, Pride and Prejudice remains a masterclass in romantic storytelling and social commentary. The famous opening line — 'It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife' — is one of the most quoted in literary history.

name: The New Testament
author: Various Authors (Apostles & Disciples of Jesus Christ)
short_description: The sacred scriptures of Christianity — the life, teachings, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ.
detailed_description: The New Testament is the second and concluding part of the Christian Bible, composed of 27 books written in Greek during the first century AD. It begins with the four Gospels — Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John — each offering an account of the life, ministry, miracles, death by crucifixion, and resurrection of Jesus Christ. The Acts of the Apostles follows, narrating the birth of the early Christian church and the missionary journeys of Paul and other apostles. The Epistles, a collection of 21 letters mostly written by the Apostle Paul, address early Christian communities across the Roman Empire, teaching on faith, grace, love, ethics, and salvation. The final book, Revelation (Apocalypse), is a prophetic and visionary text attributed to John, describing the end of times, divine judgment, and the ultimate triumph of God. At its core, the New Testament carries the message of love, forgiveness, redemption, and eternal life through faith in Jesus Christ. It has profoundly shaped Western civilization, moral philosophy, art, literature, and law. The Sermon on the Mount, the Beatitudes, the Lord's Prayer, and the Parable of the Prodigal Son are among its most enduring and universally known passages.

name: Graamyam
author: Suresh Tripunithura
short_description: A Malayalam novel rooted in the sights, sounds, and soul of Kerala's rural village life.
detailed_description: Graamyam, meaning 'rustic' or 'of the village', is a Malayalam novel by Suresh Tripunithura — an author, botanist, and officer from Kerala's Ernakulam district. The novel is deeply rooted in a traditional Kerala village setting, capturing the rich textures of rural life, nature, and the intricate social relationships that define village communities. Through vivid descriptions of green landscapes, ponds, trees, and the rhythms of countryside living, the story explores human emotions, interpersonal bonds, and the quiet tension between age-old village traditions and the slow encroachment of modern change. Suresh Tripunithura, known for weaving environmental consciousness into his literary work, brings a naturalist's eye to the narrative, making the village itself feel like a living, breathing character. Graamyam is a poignant reflection on nostalgia, belonging, and the changing face of Kerala's countryside.

name: History of Saint George (Malayalam)
author: Unknown
short_description: A Malayalam account of the life, martyrdom, and miracles of Saint George — the great Christian warrior-martyr.
detailed_description: This Malayalam work narrates the life and legacy of Saint George (Mar Geevarghese), one of the most revered saints in Christian tradition and especially venerated among the Christian communities of Kerala. Saint George, believed to have lived in the 3rd century AD in Cappadocia (present-day Turkey), was a Roman soldier of high rank who converted to Christianity and refused to renounce his faith under the orders of Emperor Diocletian. He endured prolonged torture and was ultimately martyred around 303 AD, making him one of the earliest and most celebrated Christian martyrs. The legendary account of Saint George slaying a dragon — widely depicted in Christian iconography — symbolizes the triumph of faith and good over evil. In Kerala, Saint George holds extraordinary significance; countless churches are dedicated to him across the state, and grand annual feasts (perunals) are celebrated in his honour. This Malayalam text preserves and retells the story of his courage, miracles, and sainthood for Kerala's faithful, serving both as a devotional reading and a historical chronicle of one of Christianity's most beloved figures. The author of this edition remains unknown, reflecting its origins in the oral and manuscript traditions of the Kerala Church.

name: Computer Gurukulam Hardware
author: S K Mohan
short_description: A comprehensive Malayalam guide to computer hardware fundamentals and components.
detailed_description: Computer Gurukulam Hardware by S K Mohan is an educational Malayalam-language book that serves as a foundational guide to understanding computer hardware. The book covers the essential components of a computer system including the motherboard, CPU, RAM, hard drives, power supply units, input/output devices, and peripheral connections. It explains how each hardware component functions individually and how they interconnect to form a working computer system. Written in accessible Malayalam, the book is designed to help students, beginners, and technology enthusiasts in Kerala grasp the fundamentals of computer hardware without the barrier of technical English jargon. It also touches on topics like hardware troubleshooting, assembly, and maintenance, making it a practical reference for anyone looking to understand the physical architecture of computers. As part of the Gurukulam series, it reflects a tradition of making computer education accessible to Malayalam-speaking learners.
